New York Herald, 7 July 1866, p. 2, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Bark Vivid (Br), Baker, London, 42 days, with mdse, to
Thos Dunham. Had heavy weather; shipped a sea, causing
ship to leak, and losing cutwater, &c. June 11, lat 35, lon 34,
saw a whaling bark, showing a signal, red square, letter T[?]
and white border; June 3, lat 47, lon 23, saw brig Daisy, of
Yarmouth, NS, bound E; July 4, off Montauk, spoke bark
Caroline Searmont[?], steering E.
